title: Fix Bubble PNG export download on uploaded data
observed_behavior: Bubble SVG export succeeded, but Bubble PNG export did not reliably write any downloaded file on the maintained uploaded-data path even after choosing PNG, changing the scale, and confirming export. The dialog closed, but cypress/downloads/ intermittently never received the requested PNG.
intended_behavior: Bubble PNG export should write a non-empty .png file with the requested filename and scale from the Bubble export dialog.
cause_summary: The shared raster export flow was composing an html2canvas image and then trying to force a download through a synthetic anchor click on a data URL, which was not reliable for Bubble under Cypress/Electron.
fix_summary: The shared raster export flow now converts the composed canvas to a Blob and saves it through file-saver; Bubble SVG and PNG export pass in Electron, and the existing Map PNG export regression spec stays green.
notes: Resolved while implementing B031. Bubble PNG export is no longer blocked and the maintained PNG spec has been re-enabled.

title: Preserve Bubble pie backgrounds after session restore
observed_behavior: After saving a session from a styled collapsed Bubble view and reloading the .microbetrace file, Bubble restored its widgets, collapsed aggregate sizing, and node-color-variable, but mixed aggregates stopped rendering pie-chart background images.
intended_behavior: Styled collapsed Bubble aggregates should preserve their pie-chart background-image rendering after session reload when the saved session restores node-color-variable and collapsed Bubble state.
cause_summary: Bubble was not resyncing itself when a style or full session was restored, and its collapsed rebuild path also relied on preexisting aggregate state instead of deterministically recreating collapsed nodes when needed.
fix_summary: Bubble now resyncs from the restored session/style state, rebuilds Bubble field options and widgets, and deterministically reconstructs collapsed aggregates so mixed aggregate pie backgrounds are regenerated after reload. The maintained Bubble roundtrip spec now asserts the post-reload background-image directly.
notes: Resolved while fixing B035. Verified in Electron with the maintained Bubble roundtrip spec plus the broader Bubble controls regression spec.

title: Refresh Bubble when dashboard filtering changes while Bubble is hidden
observed_behavior: With Bubble open in a Golden Layout dashboard but not currently focused, changing root filtering controls could update the global metrics and sibling panes while Bubble kept its pre-filter rendered membership until a deeper manual rebuild occurred.
intended_behavior: A dashboard Bubble pane should resync from the current session graph when filtering changes happen outside Bubble, even if Bubble was hidden when the change occurred.
cause_summary: Bubble only refreshed reliably from its own active interaction path and could keep stale rendered nodes while hidden in the dashboard.
fix_summary: Bubble now syncs from session state on `networkUpdated` and pane show, and it filters rendered data nodes back to the current visible-node set before rerendering.
notes: Closed after the maintained dashboard filtering journey passed on April 10, 2026.
